lead.title: Gradientech (Uppsala) extends its QuickMIC rapid resistance test to last-resort antibiotics, including cefiderocol
lead.deck: The new QuickMIC GN02 panel, CE-marked under IVDR, returns susceptibility results for multidrug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria in 3 h 14 min, with 95.5% essential agreement and 96.0% categorical agreement. The system already holds FDA Breakthrough Device status but remains investigational-use only in the US, without a 510(k): the next step to watch.

milestone.title: PolaSight (University of Bern spin-off) receives a CHF 100,000 Tech Seed loan from FIT for its CE mark
milestone.summary: PolaOne maps an entire fresh sample in about a minute, without staining, versus 20 to 40 minutes for a standard frozen section. The loan funds the CE mark targeted for early 2027 and the first hospital installations.
milestone.why: Less time under anaesthesia and fewer repeat operations: a typical academic spin-off ahead of its first regulatory milestone, before any funding round.

deal.thesis: Stryker has closed its acquisition of ZuriMED, the Swiss start-up behind the FiberLocker rotator cuff reinforcement (510(k) in 2024, US multicentre trial ongoing). A classic tuck-in: the acquirer buys an already-cleared device before trial data are published.

brefsEurope.title: Empatica launches WellPD, a home Parkinson's monitoring system available in 12 countries
brefsEurope.summary: A wrist unit and app measuring bradykinesia, dyskinesia and tremor with validated algorithms, described as FDA-cleared and CE-marked. It builds on the algorithms of PKG Health, acquired by Empatica in 2025.

brefsEurope.title: Episurf signs a letter of intent to sell its medtech business (Episealer, Epiguide) to Canada's Oligo Medic
brefsEurope.summary: Price undisclosed, no sale completed. Episurf is refocusing on real estate: a small cartilage-implant medtech looking for an industrial buyer.

brefsIntl.title: StimCardio raises $30M Series A led by Metis Medtech for its Rhyvive neuromodulation wristband
brefsIntl.summary: The non-invasive adjunct to atrial fibrillation ablation reduced recurrences in a randomized sham-controlled pilot. Proceeds fund the NeuroPulse 2 pivotal trial and an FDA De Novo request.

brefsIntl.title: SetPoint Medical treats its first commercial patient with its vagus nerve neurostimulator for rheumatoid arthritis
brefsIntl.summary: First case at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center after FDA approval. The company plans to study Crohn's disease and multiple sclerosis next.

brefsIntl.title: FDA grants Breakthrough Device status to Pharaoh Neuro's Neurapheresis for subarachnoid haemorrhage
brefsIntl.summary: The closed-loop system filters the patient's own cerebrospinal fluid. Founded in 2024, the company raised a $20M Series A in February 2026.

word.definition: A test that shows within hours, instead of 1 to 2 days, which antibiotics still kill a patient's bacteria.

how.t: Bacteria are isolated from blood or another sample.
They are exposed to several antibiotics at different concentrations.
Growth is measured and the algorithm returns the minimum inhibitory concentration and the verdict.

word.why: Every hour saved before the right antibiotic counts in sepsis, and resistance pushes hospitals to pay for speed. Systems are capital-heavy with recurring test and consumable revenue, but the regulatory path (IVDR, 510(k)) is long.

startups.name: Q-linea
